title: The Needle
hook: It looks down. The walls open here.
synopsis: The Hush is faster on the open moor. Rook takes the old line into the Needle, a rock gorge too narrow for it. But the gorge does not stay narrow.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The moor lamps went dark. It's here!
It's faster on the open moor. Hold the bar!
The Needle! The old line goes inside.
It's too big to come in. Go, go!
It stopped at the walls. Too big!
Now it walks on top. Watching us.
The Bowl is ahead. The walls open there.
Lights out. Stop by the rock.
The boiler hissed! It heard us!
It can't climb down. It must go round!
Reed Town! Everyone inside, it's warm!
It's still up there. It will be back.
